title: Assistance of the German Democratic Republic with the modernisation of the Syrian State Railway
author: Manfred Strauß (via Hiba Bizreh, Syrian Heritage Archive)
note: Firsthand GDR-engineer account of modernizing the Syrian State Railway (CFS), 1980–84. Confirms the direct Damascus–Aleppo line was built 1983–85. Contract sections incl. Homs–Mhin, Hama–Aleppo, Mhin–Damascus → the direct Damascus–Homs line runs via MHIN. Mentions Shanshar, the Baba Amr depot, the Homs II control centre; ~650 km of track cables, signaling for 48 buildings + 25 automatic barriers.
